notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update(), a refresh of the display list, and a read of what the case's probes name.
an id holds NULs: each written U+2400.

cases.note: the max moves from D to C and the min from C to B: mpData's ids are the category coordinates ('3' -> '2', '2' -> '1'), so both old symbols fade (200 ms cubicOut) and two new ones pop in (enter timing: 600 ms linear); the custom point by name stays and slides (update timing, 1000 ms linear)
the max stays on D with a new value: its id is the same -- it slides (update timing) and nothing fades

repeated columns: a merge raises a and lowers c -- the bundles move, the kept paths slide (each its {index, count} delay: 30 ms a step), a's new ones grow from nothing at their place, c's extra ones shrink and go
single glyphs sized to their value (symbolSize ['100%', 20]): a merge changes the values -- the main path updateProps x / y / scale / rotation, the bundle its place; {} for the delay function (0)
single glyphs at the end of their bars (symbolPosition end): a merge changes the values -- the main path's place in the bundle slides with the new length
symbolClip: the clip path updateProps its shape (the new length along the value axis)

a merge that changes values: every label not ignored moves from its old layout to its new one in its host's frame (LabelManager: update timing 1000 ms linear, the host's row) while the host's rect moves on the treemap's own (animationDurationUpdate, animationEasing quinticInOut)

a merge that adds a3 under a and d at the top and takes b2 away: the new nodes' labels have no old layout -- LabelManager fades them in (enter timing: 600 ms linear, their rows); the kept ones ride their hosts

guards.name: mp-move: the ids are the category coordinates
mp-move: the gone ones are gone after 200 ms
mp-move: the new max takes the old min symbol (both id 2) and the new min pops in
pb-repeat: the new paths of a grow
pb-repeat: c has more paths than its new count while they shrink
pb-repeat: a path waits its index * 30 ms
tml-merge: the labels ride their hosts (their own layout stays)
tml-struct: the label of a new node fades in
